surface_correction.fact: The failing driver clicks the compact ContextRulesChip and queries an open role=dialog containing the Open full view button. It never clicks Open full view. The failing surface is the compact Values popover, not the full-view controlled Dialog.

source_findings: The 8d401a3 SHA identifies the hosted workflow/driver source, not the public205 product source. Public205 product source is 2f68bc4f. Current host code and published205 product code were not established equivalent by this investigation.
The shared @ai-matrx/agents ContextRulesChip renders Popover from @ai-matrx/design-system and wraps the Open full view icon button in Tooltip. The nameless face also has a Tooltip.

Radix PopoverContent and TooltipContent both install DismissableLayer. DismissableLayer handles Escape only for its highest layer. A tooltip above the popover could consume one Escape and leave the popover open.
The screenshot shows a focus ring on Open full view after failure. It does not show whether its tooltip was open before Escape.
Current node_modules versions seen locally: @ai-matrx/agents 0.59.149, @ai-matrx/design-system 0.86.199. These do not establish the exact public205 or next release dependency versions.

ranked_hypotheses.hypothesis: The Open full view tooltip becomes the highest dismissible layer when the popover gives its first focusable button focus; the first Escape dismisses only that tooltip.
ranked_hypotheses.prediction: Before Escape, a tooltip is open and the focused element is its trigger; after one Escape, the tooltip closes but the popover stays; a second Escape, with no tooltip reopened, closes the popover.
ranked_hypotheses.one_variable_test: In an admitted exact-artifact native run, record semantic counts for open tooltips and Values popover, active element relation, and key event defaultPrevented immediately before and after Escape; compare with tooltip suppressed or focus moved to a non-tooltip element before a single Escape.

ranked_hypotheses.hypothesis: A different topmost dismissible layer is consuming Escape.
ranked_hypotheses.prediction: A non-Values layer is open before Escape and closes first; Values remains, then closes on the next Escape.
ranked_hypotheses.one_variable_test: Record all open overlay roles/data-state by safe fixed categories before and after each trusted Escape, with no page text.

ranked_hypotheses.hypothesis: The Popover dismissal callback is not reached despite it being the topmost layer.
ranked_hypotheses.prediction: Only Values is open before Escape, but one trusted keydown leaves it open; an instrumented package onEscapeKeyDown/onOpenChange trace shows whether the boundary receives the event and whether state changes or reopens.
ranked_hypotheses.one_variable_test: After excluding competing layers, trace only the Popover escape callback and onOpenChange on an exact current artifact.
